## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Big Pharma]** **Merck details structure and derivation of TROP2 ADC MK-6837** [X/@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2105312517048160628)
  * Merck published details on MK-6837, a TROP2-targeting antibody-drug conjugate originated by re-humanizing and optimizing sacituzumab (derived via Kelun’s sac-tmt backbone) to extend half-life and tune avidity.
  * The program was quietly discontinued by Merck in May 2026.

* **Transcriptomic reanalysis pinpoints splicing failure as primary driver in ALS** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.02.05.26345503)
  * Comprehensive reanalysis of NYGC ALS Consortium RNA-sequencing data across five central nervous system tissues showed that the ALS transcriptome is dominated by splicing failure and novel fusion transcripts rather than quantitative gene expression changes.

* **Study elucidates intrarenal mechanisms of semaglutide in type 2 diabetes** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04674-2)
  * A randomized placebo-controlled clinical trial combined renal histology, multiparametric MRI, and transcriptomic profiling to map the direct intrarenal protective mechanisms of GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide against diabetic kidney disease.

* **Cross-program analysis demonstrates distinct therapeutic niche for BTK degraders** [X/@andrewpannu](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2105311622361153755)
  * Evaluation of ~200 targeted protein degradation clinical programs indicates that BTK degraders achieve 83%–85% response rates in resistant tumors by clearing the entire scaffolding protein, outperforming active-site BTK inhibitors that fail against mutant scaffolds.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly’s tirzepatide and amylin combination drives weight loss but triggers dropouts** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/30/eli-lilly-zepbound-amylin-combination-drug-study/)
  * A Phase 2 trial evaluating Zepbound (tirzepatide) in combination with an investigational amylin agonist demonstrated substantial weight reduction in patients with obesity.
  * High study discontinuation rates due to adverse events raised concerns regarding the tolerability profile of the combination regimen.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer’s tilrekimig achieves primary efficacy endpoint in Phase 2 atopic dermatitis trial** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105596897796788535)
  * Tilrekimig demonstrated statistically significant skin clearance compared to placebo in a Phase 2 trial for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.
  * All tested dose cohorts met the primary endpoint of achieving EASI-75 (≥75% reduction in Eczema Area and Severity Index) at Week 16.

* **[Biotech]** **Agomab reports positive extension trial data for ontunisertib in Crohn’s disease** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105606816272892194)
  * Topline results from the STENOVA open-label extension study confirmed durable safety and efficacy for oral ALK5 inhibitor ontunisertib in patients with fibrostenosing Crohn's disease.

* **[Biotech]** **UniQure’s Huntington’s gene therapy faces durability questions in Phase 1/2 follow-up** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/01/huntingtons-disease-uniqure-drug-study-results-patients/)
  * Longer-term clinical data for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease revealed waning gene expression levels over time, drawing scrutiny over therapeutic durability despite positive patient-reported acceptance.

* **Phase 2 trial evaluates axitinib in metastatic pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26364204)
  * A prospective open-label Phase 2 trial (NCT03839498) evaluated selective VEGFR-1/2/3 inhibitor axitinib (5 mg twice daily initial dose) in patients with progressive, unresectable, or metastatic PPGL without prior tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Bristol Myers amends Phase 3 Aloft trial following liver toxicity and patient death** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/bristol-admilparant-fibrosis-aloft-study-amendment-lpa1r-contineum/831763/)
  * Bristol Myers Squibb added strict liver safety monitoring to the open-label extension of its Phase 3 Aloft study testing admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis following instances of liver damage and one patient death.
  * Uncertainty around whether the fatal liver injury was directly drug-induced caused sharp pullbacks across the LPA1R inhibitor class, including competitor Contineum Therapeutics.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 orforglipron confirms CV safety and glycemic control in Phase 3 study** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105422895409406101)
  * Phase 3 trial data for oral GLP-1 receptor agonist orforglipron demonstrated cardiovascular safety alongside sustained HbA1c reductions and weight loss in patients with type 2 diabetes.

* **Pooled analysis confirms 5-year survival advantage for neoadjuvant immunotherapy in melanoma** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04677-z)
  * An International Neoadjuvant Melanoma Consortium pooled analysis of 1,038 patients demonstrated that neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor monotherapy or combinations yield superior 5-year overall survival compared to targeted BRAF/MEK inhibitors, with major pathological response strongly predictive of survival.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA accepts Roche’s NDA for BTK inhibitor fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis with Priority Review** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-fenebrutinib-ms-fda-accept-application-btk/831746/)
  * The FDA accepted Roche’s application under Priority Review to evaluate oral BTK inhibitor fenebrutinib for relapsing and primary progressive forms of multiple sclerosis based on three Phase 3 trials.
  * Review scrutiny is expected to focus on class-wide liver toxicity risks and an imbalance in patient deaths observed across the clinical program.

* **[Biotech]** **Pierre Fabre resubmits approval application for cell therapy Ebvallo** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/phrma-cantor-ebvallo-fda-mirum-bluejay-abbvie-juvmo/831450/)
  * Pierre Fabre resubmitted its regulatory filing for Ebvallo, an allogeneic T-cell therapy targeting EBV-positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease, following two previous FDA Complete Response Letters.

* **[Biotech]** **United Therapeutics seeks court order to invalidate FDA approval of Liquidia’s Yutrepia** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105439725028786519)
  * Following a favorable patent ruling, United Therapeutics announced plans to request a court order directing the FDA to rescind NDA approval for Liquidia’s dry powder treprostinil (Yutrepia), alongside claims for past sales royalties.

* **FDA warns against unapproved compounded GLP-1 receptor agonists** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs-used-weight-loss)
  * The FDA issued a formal statement highlighting safety risks associated with unapproved compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide products marketed for weight loss, emphasizing that compounded drugs must be reserved for unmet patient-specific clinical needs.

* **FDA launches national drive to recruit advisory committee members** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-nationwide-effort-expand-scientific-expertise-and-consumer-voices-advisory-committees)
  * The agency published two Federal Register notices initiating a nationwide recruitment drive for voting scientific experts and consumer representatives across its human drug and biological product advisory committees.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **Sanofi and Regeneron expand long-acting antibody alliance in $8B deal** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105645812135149944)
  * Regeneron will receive $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion in potential development and commercial milestones to expand its global immunology partnership with Sanofi, targeting next-generation, long-acting antibody therapeutics.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly terminates chromatin remodeling alliance with Foghorn Therapeutics** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105651571547906099)
  * Lilly and Foghorn discontinued joint development of FHD-909 and dissolved their selective SMARCA2 degrader collaboration, with no further joint R&D activities planned.

* **[Biotech]** **Beam Therapeutics files lawsuit alleging IP theft by former scientist** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/30/biotech-news-updates-accusations-of-theft-new-phrma-guy/)
  * Beam Therapeutics filed a lawsuit claiming a former scientist stole proprietary gene-editing intellectual property to help found a Chinese biotech company that subsequently closed major venture backing.

* **PhRMA selects former House Majority Leader Eric Cantor as CEO** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/phrma-cantor-ebvallo-fda-mirum-bluejay-abbvie-juvmo/831450/)
  * Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America appointed Eric Cantor as its next President and CEO, effective Nov. 9, replacing long-time head Steve Ubl.

## Public Health & Policy

* **CDC loses 30% of workforce following sustained budget and administrative cuts** [Science-Based Medicine](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/the-cdc-has-been-hollowed-out/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=the-cdc-has-been-hollowed-out)
  * A 30% reduction in staffing over the past 18 months has severely disrupted core operations at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, weakening national disease tracking and emergency response capacities.

* **Finalized Medicare Part B pricing rule scales back projected savings by 96%** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/30/trump-final-globe-rule-will-save-medicare-much-less-money-on-drugs/)
  * The Trump administration published its final rule on physician-administered Medicare drugs, restricting its scope to four pharmaceutical companies and drastically reducing anticipated federal cost reductions relative to the initial proposal.

* **ARPA-H launches SURPASS program to integrate AI into clinical research** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/30/hhs-arpa-h-clinical-trials-artificial-intelligence-surpass-program/)
  * Federal health officials announced a new ARPA-H initiative aimed at using artificial intelligence to accelerate trial execution and scale clinical research capacity.
